name: edi-lens-viewer
displayName: EDI Lens - EDIFACT, X12 and HL7 Viewer
description: Read, validate, compare, query, anonymise and split UN/EDIFACT, ANSI X12 and HL7 v2 messages. Free features plus a 14-day trial of Pro; works offline, only the Pro licence check uses the network.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The folder commands (Validate Workspace, Batch Pretty Print Folder, Anonymise Folder, Validate Folder With Partner Rules, Query over a folder) need a folder on a real file system. All single-file features work in virtual workspaces.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open a UN/EDIFACT, ANSI X12 or HL7 v2 file to see its segments here.
[Open a Sample Message](command:ediLens.openSampleEdifact)
[Detect Format Of This File](command:ediLens.detectFormat)
[Getting Started Guide](command:ediLens.openWalkthrough)

Query (Pro) finds the messages that satisfy a condition, in the open file or in a folder, for example `NAD[BY]-2.1 == "5412*" AND count(LIN) > 2`.
[Run A Query](command:ediLens.query)

walkthroughs.title: Get started with EDI Lens
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample message, read its structure, check it for problems and try the Pro features with the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample message
steps.description:
EDI Lens reads UN/EDIFACT, ANSI X12 and HL7 v2 files. Open one of the short samples (invented data) to follow along, or open one of your own files.
[Open EDIFACT Sample](command:ediLens.openSampleEdifact)
[Open X12 Sample](command:ediLens.openSampleX12)
[Open HL7 Sample](command:ediLens.openSampleHl7)

steps.title: Read the outline
steps.description:
The EDI Lens view in the activity bar lists every segment with its elements and components. Select an item to jump to it; right-click to copy its path.
[Show the Outline](command:workbench.view.extension.ediLens)

steps.title: Hover a value
steps.description:
Point at any part of a segment to see its path (for example NAD[2]-3.1), the raw value, its position and its length. "Copy Path At Cursor" puts the same path on the clipboard.
[Copy Path At Cursor](command:ediLens.copyPath)

steps.title: Run validation
steps.description:
Envelopes, segment counts, control numbers and delimiters are checked when a file opens, when it is saved and while you type. Problems appear in the editor and in the Problems view with a stable code.
[Validate Current File](command:ediLens.validateFile)

steps.title: Try Pro
steps.description:
Compare, Export, Validate Workspace, dictionaries, Batch Pretty Print and the tools of the next step are Pro features. The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer; no key, account or network is needed. A licence key (one-time purchase, Personal or Business) keeps them after the trial.
[Compare With Another File](command:ediLens.compare)
[Show Licence Status](command:ediLens.licenceStatus)

steps.title: Share, check and split with Pro
steps.description:
Four Pro tools for files from partners: Anonymise makes a copy with the identifying values replaced, Validate With Partner Rules checks your own implementation guide, Query finds messages by their content and the envelope tools split, merge, renumber and acknowledge. All of them run inside the 14-day trial.
[Anonymise Message](command:ediLens.anonymise)
[Create Rules From This Message](command:ediLens.createRules)
[Run A Query](command:ediLens.query)
[Generate Acknowledgement](command:ediLens.generateAcknowledgement)

ediLens.validateOnType.markdownDescription: Check the structure of EDI files while you type (after a short pause). When off, files are checked when opened and saved. Files above 2 MB are only re-checked on save.

ediLens.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file size, in megabytes, that is parsed automatically for the outline, hovers, status bar and problems. Larger files are only checked on demand with **EDI Lens: Validate Current File**.

ediLens.maxIssues.markdownDescription: Maximum number of problems reported per file.

ediLens.hover.enabled.markdownDescription: Show the path, value, position and length of the item under the pointer. With a loaded dictionary (Pro) the hover also shows names.

ediLens.autoDetectLanguage.markdownDescription: When a file opens as UN/EDIFACT, ANSI X12 or HL7 v2 but its content is clearly another one of the three (for example an X12 file named `.edi`), switch the language to match. A language you choose by hand is not changed again in the same session.

ediLens.workspace.include.markdownDescription: Glob pattern of the files scanned by **Validate Workspace** and rewritten by **Batch Pretty Print Folder**. Validate Workspace also examines the first bytes of files without a matching extension.

ediLens.workspace.exclude.markdownDescription: Glob pattern of the files and folders that the workspace features skip.

ediLens.compare.ignoreSegments.markdownDescription: Segment ids that **Compare With Another File** leaves out, for example `UNB`, `UNZ`, `ISA`, `IEA`.

ediLens.compare.ignorePaths.markdownDescription: Paths that **Compare With Another File** skips, for example control numbers or dates. `*` matches any characters: `UNB[1]-5.*`, `MSH[1]-7`.

ediLens.compare.ignoreCase.markdownDescription: Treat upper and lower case letters as equal when comparing.

ediLens.compare.trimValues.markdownDescription: Ignore leading and trailing spaces in values when comparing.

ediLens.export.neutraliseFormulas.markdownDescription: In CSV exports, put an apostrophe in front of values that start with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, a tab or a carriage return, so spreadsheet programs do not run them as formulas. On by default for safety; turn it off when you need the exact values (for example negative amounts such as `-150.00` keep their sign but get the apostrophe while this is on).

ediLens.anonymise.profiles.markdownDescription: Built-in rule sets used by **Anonymise Message** and **Anonymise Folder**: `hl7-patient` (the main identifying fields of PID, NK1, IN1 and GT1), `x12-healthcare` (the main identifying fields of 837, 835, 270 and 271), `x12-party` (N1, N2, N3, N4 and PER of any transaction) and `edifact-party` (NAD, CTA, COM and FII). Each one applies to its own format only and replaces only the paths listed in the documentation. A rule file that lists `profiles` itself takes precedence.

ediLens.anonymise.rulesFile.markdownDescription: Rule file for **Anonymise**: a path inside the workspace folder, or an absolute path. The file is optional; its rules come before the built-in profiles.

enumDescriptions: Replace the sender and receiver ids of the envelope too. Where a rule also replaces the same id in the body as a pseudonym, both get the same replacement.
Leave the sender and receiver ids of the envelope as they are.
ediLens.anonymise.envelopeIds.markdownDescription: What **Anonymise** does with the sender and receiver ids of the envelope (`UNB`, `UNG`, `ISA06`, `ISA08`, `GS02`, `GS03`, `MSH-3` to `MSH-6`). `pseudonymise` replaces them, so the first segment of a copy does not name the parties. Choose `keep` when a copy must still be routed by a test system that looks at these ids.

ediLens.anonymise.copyUnchanged.markdownDescription: **Anonymise Folder** does not write a file in which no rule matched a value: such a file is not anonymised and is listed as unchanged. Turn this on to copy those files unchanged into the target folder as well (they are still listed as unchanged).

ediLens.rules.file.markdownDescription: Partner rule file used by **Validate With Partner Rules** and **Validate Folder With Partner Rules**: a path inside the workspace folder, or an absolute path.

ediLens.query.ignoreCase.markdownDescription: Treat upper and lower case letters as equal when **Query** compares text.

ediLens.query.maxResults.markdownDescription: Largest number of matching messages that **Query** lists in one run.

ediLens.envelope.startNumber.markdownDescription: First control number used by **Split Interchange Into Messages**, **Merge Messages Into One Interchange** and **Generate Acknowledgement**, and the value offered by **Renumber Control Numbers**.

ediLens.envelope.x12Acknowledgement.markdownDescription: Transaction set that **Generate Acknowledgement** writes for an X12 file: `997` or `999`.
